one_liner: Hand it a failed transaction hash and it tells you why in plain words — with the receipt to prove it — plus doc-grounded Q&A that admits when the docs don't cover a question.
what_it_does: Paste any failed transaction hash and this lamp reads the receipt, replays what happened, and explains the failure in plain English — like "ran out of gas" or "the contract rejected it with this reason". Its doc answers are cited, and it says so when the docs don't cover a question. Proven by 5 real transactions on the Atlantic testnet, all linked below.
